summary: Configured `/srv/data` as a persistent Btrfs subvolume, captured a read-only snapshot, modified the live data, and restored its exact earlier content. Persistence and recovery were verified after rebooting node1.
actions_performed: Installed Btrfs tooling and created a dedicated 512 MiB Btrfs filesystem image.
Mounted its `current` subvolume at `/srv/data` and added the mount to `/etc/fstab`.
Created representative application data and recorded hashes, permissions, and symlink metadata.
Changed file contents and permissions, removed a symlink, and added an unwanted file.
Recreated the live subvolume from `pre-change` and verified an exact recursive match.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed the changed boot identity, services, mount, restored data, and snapshot health.

evidence.summary: Shows `/srv/data` mounted as a Btrfs subvolume and its persistent `/etc/fstab` entry.
Records the original tree, modes, symlink and SHA-256 hashes, then creates the read-only `pre-change` snapshot.
Shows divergent hashes, permissions, removed symlink, and added unwanted file.
Recreates `current` from the snapshot; recursive comparison and explicit content, mode, link, and absence checks return `restore_exact=PASS`.

Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID `6be79844-d63a-4690-af5c-77bc02320a2d`, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID `17b5559f-170d-46cc-add1-9403fcb55f27`, and recovered services, Btrfs mount, exact data, and read-only snapshot.
